name: ADG633YRUZ-REEL7
title: Triple SPDT CMOS analog switch, ±5 V / +5 V / +3 V
summary: ADG633 holds three SPDT analog switches in one CMOS die, each with its own address input and one shared active-low enable that turns all of them off. Signals pass both ways and swing rail to rail. It runs from ±2 V to ±6 V or 2 V to 12 V, with about 52 Ω on resistance at ±5 V, sub-nanoamp leakage and guaranteed break-before-make. TSSOP parts cover −40 °C to +125 °C; LFCSP parts −40 °C to +85 °C.
key_figures: ±2 V to ±6 V, or 2 V to 12 V
52 Ω typ at ±5 V; 85 Ω typ at +5 V

circuits.title: On resistance test circuit
circuits.description: A current IDS is forced through a closed switch from S to D while S sits at VS; RON is the voltage V1 across the switch divided by IDS.

parts.value: one ADG633 switch, S to D

circuits.title: Source off leakage test circuit
circuits.description: An open switch with VS on S and VD on D, an ammeter in each lead; one reads IS(OFF), the other ID(OFF).

parts.value: one ADG633 switch, S to D

circuits.title: Drain off leakage test circuit
circuits.description: An open switch with S unconnected and VD on D through an ammeter that reads ID(OFF).

parts.value: one ADG633 switch, S to D

notes: The ammeter label ID(ON) should read ID(OFF).

circuits.title: Channel on leakage test circuit
circuits.description: EN low enables the part; S1A and S1B are tied together at VS, so D1 connects to VS whichever side is on. An ammeter from D to VD reads ID(ON).

circuits.title: Transition time test circuit
circuits.description: A 0 V to 3 V pulse, terminated in 50 Ω, drives A0, A1 and A2 together with EN low, so D1 flips between S1A at VS1A and S1B at VS1B. D1 drives 300 Ω and 35 pF; tTRANSITION runs from the 50% point of the address edge to the 90% point of the output.

circuits.title: Break-before-make delay test circuit
circuits.description: As the transition-time setup, but S1A and S1B are tied together at VS. When the address changes the output dips while neither side is on; tBBM is the time between its 80% points.

circuits.title: Enable delay test circuit
circuits.description: A0, A1 and A2 are grounded, so S1A is the selected side, held at VS; S1B is grounded. A 0 V to 3 V pulse with 50 Ω termination drives EN. tON(EN) and tOFF(EN) run from the 50% point of the enable edge to the 90% point of the output across 300 Ω and 35 pF.

circuits.title: Charge injection test circuit
circuits.description: Address lines grounded select S1A to D1. VS through RS feeds S; D drives a 1 nF load. A 3 V to 0 V step on EN switches it; the output step ΔVOUT times CL gives the injected charge.
notes: S and D are the selected switch: with A2 = A1 = A0 = 0 that is S1A to D1.

circuits.title: Off isolation test circuit
circuits.description: EN is held at logic 1, so every switch is off. A network analyzer drives S through 50 Ω, with S also terminated in 50 Ω, and reads D across its 50 Ω input; off isolation is 20 log(VOUT/VS).
notes: S and D are one switch: with A2 = A1 = A0 = 0 that is S1A to D1.

circuits.title: Bandwidth test circuit
circuits.description: EN and the address lines are low, so the switch is on. A network analyzer drives S through 50 Ω and reads D across 50 Ω; insertion loss is 20 log of VOUT with the switch over VOUT without it.
notes: Insertion loss = 20 log (VOUT with switch / VOUT without switch)
S and D are one switch: with A2 = A1 = A0 = 0 that is S1A to D1.

circuits.title: Channel-to-channel crosstalk test circuit
circuits.description: The address lines are grounded; EN has no connection. A network analyzer drives one channel's drain (DB) through 50 Ω; a second channel has its source (SA) terminated in 50 Ω and its drain (DA) read across 50 Ω. Crosstalk is 20 log(VOUT/VS).
notes: SA and DA are one switch (S1A to D1 with A0 = 0); DB is the drain of another channel (D2).

where.VOUT: level at D of the off switch

operation.text: Three SPDT switches, each with a common drain (D1, D2, D3) and two sources (A and B). A0 picks the side of switch 1, A1 of switch 2, A2 of switch 3: logic 0 connects the A source, logic 1 the B source. With EN high all six paths are off whatever the address; EN low lets the address act.
An on switch passes current either way, and the signal may swing anywhere from VSS to VDD. S and D pins can each serve as input or output.
On an address change the switch that was on opens before the other closes, so the two sources are never shorted together; tBBM is at least 10 ns.

Runs from ±2 V to ±6 V dual supplies or a single 2 V to 12 V supply, and is specified at ±5 V, +5 V and +3 V. For single-supply use VSS connects to GND. Supply current is typically 0.01 µA, so typical power is below 0.1 µW.
The digital inputs switch between 0.8 V and 2.4 V at +5 V and ±5 V, which suits TTL and CMOS drivers. At 2.7 V to 3.6 V the limits are 0.5 V and 2.0 V.
Overvoltage on Ax, EN, S or D is clamped by internal diodes. The current into those diodes must stay within the absolute maximum ratings.
The LFCSP exposed pad may float, or be connected to VDD, VSS or GND.
Offered as a package upgrade to the 74HC4053, MAX4053 and MAX4583.
